sourceVersion: UCS 2025-2026 District Calendar overview; PDF metadata created October 16, 2025
seoTitle: Utica Schools Calendar 2025–26: UCS Dates & PDF
seoDescription: UCS began Aug. 26, 2025, and ends June 10, 2026. See half days, conferences, exams, DPPD closures, breaks, hours, official PDF, and .ics dates.
heroSummary: UCS students began Tuesday, August 26, 2025, with a half day for elementary students, and the last day is Wednesday, June 10, 2026, with a half day for all K-12 students. Winter Holiday Break runs December 22-January 2, Mid-Winter Break February 16-20, and Spring Break March 30-April 3.
calendarNotes: The opening date is a half day only for elementary students; secondary students start the same day without that half-day label. Secondary conference day is October 2, while elementary conference day is October 15. Elementary students also have marking-period half days October 31 and March 20 plus an unlabeled-purpose half day March 27. Secondary exam half days occur December 17-18 and June 8; December 19 and June 9-10 shorten the day for all students. The final date is itself a K-12 half day. Teacher Full Day DPPD closures appear September 17, October 22, November 4, and January 14. The overview labels marking-period endings only on October 31, December 19, and March 20, so no additional grading-period dates are inferred.

customSections.label: Which UCS Students Have a Half Day?
customSections.content: The grade scope changes throughout the year. The table keeps conference, exam, marking-period, and all-student half days separate instead of presenting one undifferentiated early-dismissal list.

rows: First day of school for all K-12

customSections.label: Use the School's Half-Day Clock
customSections.content: For 2025-26, early elementary schools dismiss at 11:34 a.m. and late elementaries at 12:09 p.m. Junior highs dismiss at 10:57 a.m.; senior highs and several high-school programs at 10:17 a.m.; the Alternative Learning Center at 10:32 a.m. CSI and MST use separate morning and afternoon sessions.

customSections.label: Only Explicit Marking-Period Dates Are Included
customSections.content: The overview names October 31, December 19, and March 20 as marking-period endings. It does not publish marking-period start dates, report-card dates, or a fourth marking-period label, so those values are intentionally not reconstructed.

calendarFaqs.q: When did Utica Community Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: All K-12 students started Tuesday, August 26, 2025. Elementary students attended a half day; the official overview does not apply that half-day label to secondary students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is UCS Winter Holiday Break in 2025-26?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Holiday Break runs Monday, December 22, 2025, through Friday, January 2, 2026. The overview resumes its listed schedule after that date.

calendarFaqs.q: When is UCS Mid-Winter Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Mid-Winter Break is February 16-20, 2026, with no school for K-12 students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is UCS Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 30, through Friday, April 3, 2026. The elementary half day on March 27 is a separate calendar entry before the break.

calendarFaqs.q: Which UCS dates are secondary exam half days in 2025-26?
calendarFaqs.a: Secondary students have exam half days December 17-18, 2025, and June 8, 2026. December 19 and June 9-10 are half days for all K-12 students.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of Utica Community Schools in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day is Wednesday, June 10, 2026. It is a half day for all K-12 students.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the 2025-26 UCS overview publish every marking period?
calendarFaqs.a: No. It explicitly labels marking-period endings on October 31, December 19, and March 20. This page does not infer missing starts, report-card dates, or an unlabeled fourth ending.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 14, 2026, against the official UCS 2025-2026 District Calendar overview and published school-hour page.
sourceReviewDetails: The local PDF and current official direct PDF are byte-for-byte identical and have the same SHA-256 checksum.
The one-page PDF was text-extracted, rendered, and visually checked for all 25 printed rows.
Elementary, secondary, and all-student half days were kept separate; no unlabeled grading dates were inferred.
Published dismissal times are identified as 2025-26 hours and are not represented as permanent future schedules.
